approved_translation: Bad company corrupts; choose your companions wisely, for they shape your fate.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: One day a young Lion came suddenly upon a Wolf. The Wolf was not able to get away, so he said to the Lion: "Please, Great Lion, could you take me to your den, and let me live with you and your mate? Then the Wolf said to himself: "The Lion has been shot, and soon he will die. I will now go back to my old home in the woods." And so he did.
